supersedes.reason: The v1 created_utc was accidentally 103 seconds in the future and was abandoned before any model execution or new outcome inspection; the scientific design below is unchanged.

question: Does a small, exact bank of layer-8/9 module writes compose the aspectual-anchor state that first becomes causally sufficient at resid:10?

intervention.value: exact replacement from the paired native donor cache
intervention.module_arms: all 16 subsets including the native empty set
intervention.head_arms: all nine singleton pre-projection heads of attn:09

predictions.pred_a_authority_and_native_capability: The parent hashes and all eight ordered native capability cells reproduce exactly.
predictions.pred_b_four_module_composition: The frozen four-module bank has A1 and A2 mean recovery at least 0.65, direction fraction at least 0.90 in each family, P effect at most 0.20, and C absolute recovery at most 0.35.
predictions.pred_c_attn09_is_necessary_within_bank: Removing attn:09 from the full bank lowers mean target recovery by at least 0.25; its exact factorial Shapley contribution is the largest of the four modules.
predictions.pred_d_head_resolution: Report all nine attn:09 singleton heads without adaptive subset rescue; a head is localized only if its A1 and A2 mean recovery are each at least 0.15, direction fractions are each at least 0.80, P is at most 0.20, and C is at most 0.35.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage: Every one of 25 registered arms produces all 128 row outcomes, with finite logits and no dropped record.

terminal.screen: A, B, C, and E pass. D is a separately reported head-resolution result and cannot rescue the module-bank terminal.
terminal.null: The run is valid but B or C fails.
terminal.invalid: Any authority, capability, exact-coverage, finiteness, instrument, or execution check fails. No threshold, site, layer, head subset, row, or construction may be changed after opening outcomes.

novelty: The parent tested singleton residual, module, and conditionally eligible head swaps. This is the first exact multi-module factorial at the aspectual onset and the first non-adaptive L9 head decomposition for this behavior.
